messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Shopping and Retail" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Please find attached your latest document(s) from RS.', 'Thanks for your order.', 'Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, arnold@highwayman.co.uk', 'Thank You For Buying From Walmart - Confirmation Needed', 'After this term, the required sum will be taken from your payment card and the subscription will be brought into action.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, gradwell@highwayman.com', "If, within 30 days after receipt of your purchase you're not completely satisfied, return it for the price you paid, or we will gladly replace it.", 'If this sign up was made by someone else, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the sign-up specifications in this message, and then change the password on your profile, maybe it was stolen.', 'You sent a payment of 39.00 GBP to Skype (sales@skype.com)', 'Your order ID:8705-74589242 accepted.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
